name: warrior-cats-signal
description: WebRTC signalling relay for Warrior Cats two-player co-op. Introduces two iPads, then gets out of the way.

scripts.//: Plain http on LOOPBACK ONLY. Vite proxies /signal to it, so the relay is never exposed on the network and never needs a certificate. Do not add --ip 0.0.0.0.
scripts.//port: 8791, not wrangler's default 8787: another project on this laptop listens there, and when wrangler cannot bind, Vite proxies /signal into that server instead. The health probe passes and pairing fails, which reads as a router problem. Must match SIGNAL_PORT in vite.config.ts and NET_SIGNAL_PORT in src/game/constants.ts.
